sections.title: 核心词汇
sections.desc: 双栏练习 · 描红 2 遍 + 临写 2 遍

items.head: challenge
items.note: face a challenge 面临挑战

items.head: prefer
items.note: prefer A to B 喜欢 A 胜过 B

items.head: confuse
items.note: confusing 修饰物；confused 修饰人

items.head: quit
items.note: quit doing sth 放弃做某事

items.head: fluent
items.note: be fluent in 通晓（某种语言）

items.head: improve
items.note: improve on sth 在某事上改进

sections.title: 短语与例句
sections.desc: 描整句，说明行给出短语与搭配

items.head: sign up (for sth)
items.note: sign up for a course　后接名词或动名词
items.trace: I should sign up for advanced literature.

items.head: be good at (sth / doing)
items.note: be good at it　勿写成 be good in
items.trace: I like English and I'm good at it.

items.head: make the team
items.note: make = 成功成为；同类 make friends
items.trace: I'll improve so that I can make the team next year.

items.head: keep up with
items.note: keep up with sb 跟上某人
items.trace: I'm a bit worried about keeping up with the other students.

items.head: get used to (sth / doing)
items.note: ★ to 是介词，后接名词或动名词
items.trace: It'll be quite difficult to get used to all the homework.

items.head: on one's own
items.note: improve on my own　区别 of one's own（自己的）
items.trace: I'll find a way to improve on my own.

items.head: focus on / concentrate on
items.trace: Spending too much time online makes it difficult to focus on other things.

sections.title: 描红短文
sections.desc: 先整段描红，再整段临写

items.head: The Freshman Challenge（课文节选）
items.text: Hi! My name is Adam and I'm a freshman at senior high school. Going from junior high school to senior high school is a really big challenge. The first week was a little confusing. I had to think very carefully about which courses to take. My adviser recommended that I should sign up for advanced literature, because I like English and I'm good at it.

items.head: Letter of Advice（建议信节选）
items.text: I understand quite well that you are anxious. I recommend that you talk to your friend about his behaviour. Spending too much time online makes it difficult to focus on other things.

sections.title: 默写自检
sections.desc: 只看中文提示，写出完整英文
